embeds.title: Marketplace Access Request
embeds.description:
Want to become a verified marketplace seller?

Before requesting access, please ensure you:
- Can provide clear product descriptions
- Will maintain accurate pricing
- Only sell legal and authorized products
- Understand our delivery & refund policies
- Will maintain professional communication

A support team member will review your application and respond shortly.

embeds.title: 📜 Marketplace Seller Guidelines
embeds.description: Please review our marketplace guidelines carefully before applying for seller access. These rules help maintain a safe and professional environment for all users.
